meta.title: James Acaster Traitors rumour addressed 🤫
meta.summary: The BBC has rejected claims that James Acaster made a complaint regarding teasing on The Celebrity Traitors, calling the reports categorically untrue.

facts: The BBC denied that James Acaster complained about teasing or banter from Romesh Ranganathan and Rob Beckett on the show.
The BBC stated that claims of teasing amongst the cast on the show and claims of complaints about teasing are categorically untrue.
The BBC stated that there were no incidents of that nature and there is no evidence to support the allegations.

beats.say: Did James Acaster really complain about teasing on The Celebrity Traitors?
Reports claimed James filed a formal complaint regarding banter from Romesh Ranganathan and Rob Beckett.
Now, the broadcaster has officially stepped in to set the record straight.
The BBC denied that James Acaster made any complaint, stating claims of teasing are categorically untrue.
The BBC confirmed there were no incidents of that nature and no evidence exists. Are you watching the series?
